scope: Full fixed-baseline Codex client; ChatGPT-only excluded by evidence; third-party implementations externalized
currentAuthorizationScope: analysis and behavior verification only; no client implementation begun

analysisMilestones.name: 功能范围与模式
deliverables: 入口到功能/支撑/排除/待定的逐项关联
完整分母与未解决分母
exitCriteria: 每个发现入口被登记并有归属状态
导航与展示不机械计为用户功能
仅证据充分的 ChatGPT-only 分支进入排除表

analysisMilestones.name: 运行时与依赖决定
deliverables: 逐依赖的来源/版本/引入方式
运行时能力和 ABI 决定
exitCriteria: 独立构建输入可取得或有可验证替代路线
第三方修改、私有和 native/Wasm 分开处理
失败能力关联受影响功能

analysisMilestones.name: 关键链路与源码映射
deliverables: 入口到 receiver/状态/存储的映射
原范围到拟恢复模块的映射
动态边界的行为触发条件
exitCriteria: 每个保留功能有足以指导实现的契约
错误/取消/清理按真实分支保留
模块归属与依赖来源可追溯

analysisMilestones.name: 行为对照与实施验收
deliverables: 正常/失败/取消/重开对照
exitCriteria: 已执行与未执行严格分列
未触发条件保留在完整范围
证据范围覆盖结论后再声明完成

implementationMilestones.name: 独立工程与运行时
startConditions: 独立运行时来源、构建输入和目标平台明确
exitCriteria: 干净构建、安装、启动均不读取原应用路径
所有存储位置和认证来源明确
implementationMilestones.failureAction: 能力/ABI 失败则重开运行时决定

implementationMilestones.name: 传输与后台适配
startConditions: 所用协议/provider/端口/信任条件明确
exitCriteria: 请求/响应/通知/超时/异常/断连/销毁/能力释放逐项通过
公开后台差异逐项适配且不静默删除字段
implementationMilestones.failureAction: 保留失败契约并重开对应 adapter 决定

implementationMilestones.name: 状态与基础界面
startConditions: 各功能的模式条件、状态所有者和存储契约明确
exitCriteria: 初始化、并发写、错误和重开符合基线
迁移失败可恢复备份
implementationMilestones.failureAction: 恢复备份并保留原数据，内存成功不算落盘

implementationMilestones.name: 任务生命周期
startConditions: 提交/事件/审批/中断合同可驱动真实链路
exitCriteria: 后台接受、终态与界面分别证明
取消和重启恢复不靠本地改状态或重发冒充
implementationMilestones.failureAction: 重开失败场景，不据错误提示自动重发任务

implementationMilestones.name: 其余 Codex 能力
startConditions: 每项功能的平台依赖、条件和契约明确
exitCriteria: 核对真实 worker/Git/PTY/remote/权限
全部实际发现功能均在完整表中
implementationMilestones.failureAction: 平台不可用与未实现分别列出，不缩小目标

implementationMilestones.name: 剥离与升级
startConditions: 模式、共享依赖、依赖版本与数据格式有证据
exitCriteria: 无误删共享能力且维护源码无第三方实现副本
新基线差分定位模块和回归场景
implementationMilestones.failureAction: 停止该版本迁移并恢复备份/旧版本

implementationMilestones.name: 完整验收
startConditions: 完整功能分母及所有未通过项可枚举
exitCriteria: 每个保留功能有实际结果
mock/占位/未决服务/未通过项不算完成
implementationMilestones.failureAction: 失败项返回所属里程碑

originalAnalysisCriteria.requirement: 输入版本和哈希固定且不混版
所有发现文件/入口/功能登记并说明覆盖
originalAnalysisCriteria.proofRequired: files, entry reconciliation and feature denominators

originalAnalysisCriteria.requirement: 模式归属与排除理由可追溯
originalAnalysisCriteria.proofRequired: per-branch mode and shared dependency closure

originalAnalysisCriteria.requirement: 保留功能的职责和关键边界可解释
第三方版本/来源有据，未知项有行动
map、缺失输入、REA限制和动态关系有说明
主要行为与静态结论对照，未验有条件
originalAnalysisCriteria.proofRequired: actual behavior and scoped unexecuted scenarios

originalAnalysisCriteria.requirement: 结构、顺序和验收引用分析证据
originalAnalysisCriteria.proofRequired: source mapping, milestone dependencies and acceptance coverage

historicalRestorationDecisions.title: Separate source preparation from integration acceptance
historicalRestorationDecisions.finding: v7 gives W06 a W03 dependency and M2 a whole-M1 dependency. These are valid integration gates, but overconstrain preparation of source contracts and state logic.
historicalRestorationDecisions.decision: Use two scheduling graphs. Source preparation uses evidenced contracts; native/host/product acceptance keeps runtime, provider, persistence and complete-scope gates. Finishing source preparation does not finish its parent milestone.
acceptance: The source graph has no W03 integration prerequisite for W01/W02/W05/W06 preparation.
Real persistence, isolation, permissions, renderer lifecycle and packaging still require the appropriate runtime integration.
M1 through M7 remain future milestones; this publication starts no client implementation.

historicalRestorationDecisions.title: Preserve one shared composer implementation
historicalRestorationDecisions.finding: The saved product-flow contract connects the Codex-specific entry and chat/work entries to shared composer/controller bindings; local task routing also has Work consumers.
historicalRestorationDecisions.decision: Place entry policy in home-surface-policy, retain shared home-composer and local-submission, and isolate only evidenced chat-specific render branches. Do not copy the shared composer or drop the primary chunk.
acceptance: Codex entry reaches the shared controller and local task path with its own entry policy.
Location, authentication family, product mode, session kind and backend eligibility remain distinct values.
Only branch-level exclusions with a checked consumer closure may be removed.

historicalRestorationDecisions.title: Give privileged browser settings an explicit runtime and service gate
historicalRestorationDecisions.finding: The fixed public Electron guest probe rejected eight privileged URLs while owned host/guest controls passed; direct URL embedding does not supply the four settings families.
historicalRestorationDecisions.decision: Treat contact information, password manager, extensions and site settings as runtime/service requirements owned by W03 and consumed by T26. Keep both a suitable independent runtime and equivalent first-party UI/service adapters as unqualified alternatives. Reject direct stock embedding as a completed route.
acceptance: Each family has actual independent data/service operations, capability and partition checks.
Mount identity, disposal, navigation/history, theme and late-response cleanup match caller contracts.
No route qualifies through a URL substitution, empty page, original installed runtime copy or a fabricated success flag.

historicalRestorationDecisions.title: Update final scope dependencies to all current task groups
historicalRestorationDecisions.finding: v7 embeds 103 definitions and W09 names T01 through T16, whereas current coverage contains 274 definitions owned by T01 through T33.
historicalRestorationDecisions.decision: Freeze v17/v8 as this plan's input snapshot, carry all 33 task groups, 64 support operations, six shared-consumer relations and every unresolved-scope record, and make final acceptance depend on all 33 groups plus unresolved scope closure.
acceptance: Every current feature has exactly one owning task and retains its current source, scenarios and conditions.
The 15 pending settings pages, 968 legacy records, associations and other required capabilities remain in scope.
The 919 unexecuted product specifications and unknown modes are not promoted to passed or excluded.

restorationDecisions.decision: Use all 340 definitions and 45 owners from the current coverage. Final scope acceptance depends on every owner and unresolved-scope disposition.
